The '''Demo Wiki''' is a demo of [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/MediaWiki MediaWiki],
the engine behind Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia projects. Its pages are
imported from the <code>seed/*.wiki</code> files by <code>./seed.sh</code>, so
the list below is everything that was seeded.

== About this demo ==

This wiki runs as its own Docker Compose project in
<code>nexuslbs/playground/demo-wiki</code> and publishes
[http://localhost:12349/ host port 12349]. The project README has the one
command that brings it up and the DEMO-ONLY accounts.
